paperTitle: CancerST: A Tamagotchi-Style Serious Game for Thyroid Cancer Awareness and Management
centralContribution: This work introduces CancerST, a Tamagotchi-style serious game designed to enhance thyroid cancer awareness and management through gamified learning. It innovates by personifying the thyroid gland into an interactive virtual pet, offering a novel channel for disseminating information about thyroid health and promoting a ludic understanding of management strategies. The game was playtested with three thyroid health specialists, generating qualitative feedback affirming its potential as a useful educational tool.

gameObjects.visualMetaphor: CancerST is presented as a Tamagotchi-style serious game aimed at improving thyroid cancer awareness and management. Its innovation lies in personifying the thyroid gland as a virtual pet to deliver educational content and promote an engaging understanding of health strategies. Initial qualitative feedback from thyroid specialists supports its educational utility.
gameObjects.whyThisFive: This unit highlights the core innovation and purpose of the developed game, emphasizing its unique approach to health education.

gameObjects.conceptualOrigin: Abstract Summary: Problem of Thyroid Cancer and Gamified Solution
gameObjects.visualMetaphor: Thyroid cancer is globally prevalent, with significant new cases and fatalities projected annually, particularly affecting women. Despite effective treatments, there's a recognized research gap in serious games for thyroid cancer awareness and management. This paper addresses this gap by proposing CancerST, a virtual pet game inspired by Tamagotchi-style mechanics, to leverage engaging gameplay for healthcare education related to thyroid health.
gameObjects.whyThisFive: This unit provides a concise summary of the paper's context, the problem it addresses, and its innovative gamified approach.
